metatron — a ring-oriented language and virtual machine
  PhaseShift Studio

RUN THE CONTAINER
  docker run -d --name metatron \
    -p 8555:8555 -p 8777:8777 \
    -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
    --group-add "$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock)" \
    ghcr.io/phaseshift-studio/metatron:latest \
    "[boot=><boot/docker.boot.mtron>,user=>avatar,web=>[http=><http://0.0.0.0:8777>,ws=><ws://0.0.0.0:8555>],log=>info]"

ENDPOINTS (once running)
  ws://<host>:8555/mtron    mtron repl console
  ws://<host>:8555/mcp      mcp over websocket
  http://<host>:8777/mcp    mcp over http (post json-rpc)
  http://<host>:8777/       web root (index page)

CONSOLE
  docker exec -it metatron wsplus ws://localhost:8555/mtron

NOTES
  - the docker socket mount + --group-add are required for dckrspace::T — the
    boot pulls its infra (sqlite / postgres / janusgraph / ...) containers via
    the HOST docker socket.
  - override the boot or its args by appending a boot-args string as the command.
  - full docs: dist/docker/README.md in the repo.
